glosses: To supply with energy, especially electricity; to turn on power to (something).

examples.text: Whenever we energize that circuit we blow a fuse.

glosses: To use strength in action; to act or operate with force or vigor; to act in producing an effect.

examples.text: Of all men it is true that they feel and energize first, they reflect and judge afterwards.

examples.text: The 13-mile section from Tring to Watford, on which work is further ahead than elsewhere south of Rugby, is likely to be energised for crew training in advance of the Rugby-Euston extension; a Crewe-Liverpool multiple-unit set is already at Stonebridge Park depot ready for use on this work.
